title: Reproducibility materials for Why multifunctional structures persist under conflicting selection
description: Reproducibility materials accompanying the theory manuscript 'Why multifunctional structures persist under conflicting selection'. The package contains the manuscript source, supporting theory, figure sources, executable model/process implementation, claim verifier, regression tests, anonymity audit, and checksum manifest. The manuscript asks why comparable functional conflicts have different natural resolutions and develops three selective states that can maintain persistent integration: adaptive integration, historical or developmental trapping, and ecological stabilization.
